# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- For Draconia Cards UI, the user prefers an orange outline to mark the actively selected deck/card and wants stronger, more visible borders plus clearly clickable button styling and press feedback across supported platforms.
- For Draconia Cards, the user wants new cards displayed left-to-right with the newest cards on the left, a clearly visible orange outline around the actively edited card, stronger visible card borders, and persistent restoration of the last edited card when reopening a deck.
- For each meaning row, the user wants the active/default Display Style (Normal for new meanings) visibly selected in the picker, not merely applied implicitly.
- For Draconia Cards, use Resources/Images/no_bgdraconiaicon.png in the header without the green tile background, sized to match the former 56×56 logo area; this is separate from changing the app launcher icon.

## Kanji Entry Guidelines
- For the kanji entry, use a responsive width of about half the available window rather than a fixed device-independent width.
- For new meaning entries, keep Normal as the default display style.
